view_notes.back: Leaf fan dominates, bark abdomen/legs remain coherent. Reference offers no exact rear view; no material repair effect visible.

view_notes.right: Pale strip runs up underside of arch. Candidate extends terminal connection nearer skull; predecessor has a small exposed terminal ledge. A clean visual join is modestly improved, not proof of articulation clearance.
view_notes.top: Paired appendages and wing roots read consistently. Overlapping plate ribbons remain at neck. No material repair effect at this full-frame view.

view_notes.diag-back: Back of skull and dorsal arch remain continuous in appearance; fan and abdomen have consistent construction. No direct concept counterpart.
view_notes.diag-left: Exposed layered collar remains jagged but visually plausible bark. Candidate is slightly fuller under skull. Forearms overlap behind head in projection, not independently a mesh defect.
view_notes.diag-right: Long pale zigzag throat/ribbon and angular collar remain visible. Candidate local closure is preferable but does not change the elongated neck character.
